notes: Row/bank naming follows the catalogue: bank 't' = rows a-e, bank 'b' = rows f-j. In the picture the rows a-e are the lower half, so the button's lower legs are in 4t.e / 6t.e and its upper legs in 4b.f / 6b.f.

The pushbutton legs are assumed to be at columns 4 and 6, with the two legs in the same column joined internally (side 1 = column 4 connected to 5V, side 2 = column 6 connected to pin 2 and the pull-down resistor); pressing joins the two columns.
The lower power rails in the picture are named bp (red + row) and bn (blue/black - row). Exact rail hole numbers (bp.2, bp.4, bn.2, bn.9) are approximated from the picture.
The resistor sits in row d, columns 6 and 9; the black ground jumper is in 9t.c. The resistor is 10k ohm, entered as value=10000.
The built-in LED on pin 13 is on the Arduino itself and has no external circuit, so there are no edges for it.
